is-there-someone-else.name: Is There Someone Else
is-there-someone-else.question: Is there someone else?
is-there-someone-else.shape: What changed, when it turned, what her own evidence proves, what the quiet is worth to him, what the watching has replaced, where it ends up, and the one question that gets an answer.

positions.name: What actually changed
positions.job: The specific thing that is different now — the one she could name out loud, not the feeling that something is off

positions.name: The week it turned
positions.job: The point his attention moved, and what else was changing for him then. The turn itself, not the day she noticed it

positions.name: What her evidence adds up to
positions.job: What the small things she has been collecting actually prove, and the conclusion they only look like they carry

positions.name: What he gets out of not explaining
positions.job: What staying vague hands him, and what he would lose the day he explained himself

positions.name: What the watching has replaced
positions.job: What the checking has taken the place of in her day. The thing she used to spend that hour on

positions.name: Where the watching ends up
positions.job: What the watching hardens into if it goes on, and the part of it that stays after the question is answered

positions.name: The question that gets an answer
positions.job: The one thing she can ask him that gets an answer either way, and what asking it costs her

is-it-too-late-for-me.name: Is It Too Late For Me
is-it-too-late-for-me.question: Is it too late for me?
is-it-too-late-for-me.shape: The thing she thinks she missed, then who handed her the deadline, what holding it spares her, what it has already taken, what she keeps walking past, and the first move.

positions.name: What she thinks she has missed
positions.job: The specific thing she believes has gone past her. Not her age — the one thing she thinks the years took

positions.name: Where the deadline came from
positions.job: Who handed her the timetable she measures herself against, and what she was promised for keeping to it

positions.name: What 'too late' spares her
positions.job: What deciding it was too late keeps her safe from. What she has not had to attempt while it was true

positions.name: What the waiting has already taken
positions.job: What the years of holding still have already taken from her. One specific loss, not a general sadness

positions.name: What she keeps walking past
positions.job: What the thing she wants looks like at this age, and why she has not recognised it so far

positions.name: The first thing that is hers
positions.job: The first move she can make on it, and the part of that move she will want to skip

will-i-ever-have-my-own-place.name: Will I Ever Have My Own Place
will-i-ever-have-my-own-place.question: Will I ever have a place of my own?
will-i-ever-have-my-own-place.shape: The reason she gives, then where she learned it was not for her, what her staying put keeps running, the place she has been holding out for, what she wants the door for, what another year costs, and what she can start alone.

positions.name: The reason she gives
positions.job: The reason she gives when somebody asks why she has not got her own place yet

positions.name: Where she learned it was not for her
positions.job: The first time she was shown that a place of her own belongs to other kinds of people

positions.name: What her staying put keeps running
positions.job: What her staying where she is keeps going, and who would have to make another arrangement the day she moved

positions.name: The place she has been holding out for
positions.job: The particular place she has been waiting for, and what it would have to include before she counted it

positions.name: What she wants the front door for
positions.job: What she wants a place of her own to make possible. The specific thing she cannot do where she is now

positions.name: What another year in it costs
positions.job: What one more year of the present arrangement takes from her, on top of the money

positions.name: What she can start on her own
positions.job: The single thing she can put in motion without another person agreeing to it, and what it costs her

should-i-stay-or-go.name: Should I Stay Or Go
should-i-stay-or-go.question: Should I stay or should I go?
should-i-stay-or-go.shape: The plain record of a month, then what her own behaviour has already settled, what she is waiting for permission to do, what staying still pays, what the deciding has cost, and what the decision asks of her first.

positions.name: What the last month looked like
positions.job: The plain record of the last month between them, as it happened, not as either of them tells it

positions.name: What she has already decided
positions.job: What her own behaviour over the last year says she has already settled, whatever she still says out loud

positions.name: The permission she is waiting for
positions.job: The event she is waiting for that would make going defensible, and who she is preparing to explain it to

positions.name: What staying still pays
positions.job: What staying hands her that she would lose the same week she left. Not love — the practical thing

positions.name: What being undecided has cost
positions.job: What the years of not deciding have taken from her. One thing she used to do and no longer does

positions.name: What the decision asks of her first
positions.job: The first thing the decision she has already made would ask of her, and the part she keeps postponing

can-i-trust-anyone-again.name: Can I Trust Anyone Again
can-i-trust-anyone-again.question: Can I ever trust anyone again?
can-i-trust-anyone-again.shape: The checking she does now, then what the not-knowing taught her, what the guard still keeps off her, what she misreads as a warning, what the carefulness costs, what she is waiting to be given, and the smallest thing she could risk.

positions.name: What she checks now
positions.job: The checking she does now without deciding to. The specific habit that was not there before

positions.name: What the not-knowing taught her
positions.job: What she learned to do in the stretch before she found out, and how well it worked

positions.name: What the guard still keeps off her
positions.job: What the checking is still protecting her from. The thing she has decided she will not be again

positions.name: What she reads as a warning
positions.job: The thing she takes for a red flag that is only a difference, and the one she talks herself out of

positions.name: What the carefulness costs
positions.job: What being this careful takes out of an ordinary week. Not loneliness — the practical thing it stops her doing

positions.name: What would have to be true first
positions.job: The proof she is waiting for before she risks anything, and who she has decided must supply it

positions.name: The smallest thing she could risk
positions.job: The smallest true thing she could tell somebody, and what it would cost her if it went wrong

where-is-he-and-have-i-already-met-him.name: Where Is He, And Have I Already Met Him
where-is-he-and-have-i-already-met-him.question: Where is he — and have I already met him?
where-is-he-and-have-i-already-met-him.shape: The list she is scanning against, then where the list came from, the one thing that would actually mark him, what she keeps taking for it, the one she already decided about, and the habit in the way.

positions.name: The list she is looking against
positions.job: What she has been scanning for. The list she would give if somebody asked her what she wants

positions.name: Where the list came from
positions.job: Who she built that list with, and which item on it belongs to somebody else entirely

positions.name: What she would know him by
positions.job: The one thing she has never been given, and how it would show in the first hour of knowing somebody

positions.name: What she keeps taking for it
positions.job: What she has been reading as the start of something, and what that attention is actually for

positions.name: The one she already decided about
positions.job: Somebody already in her life who was placed early and never looked at again. What did the placing

positions.name: What she would have to drop
positions.job: The one habit she would have to give up before she could see him at all, and what giving it up costs
